assets.description: Loose drum basket: the dynamic-object demonstrator, spawned and turned inside a placed washing machine's cavity, behind the porthole.
White resin patio table for the pool deck.
White resin patio chair matching the pool table.
Chrome pool ladder: two handrails standing on the basin floor, curving out over the deck edge, with four non-skid treads.
Freestanding commercial privacy curtain module: two posts on foot plates, an extruded top track and a gathered pleated cloth panel.
Half-width end module that closes a curtain run.
L-shaped curtain module that turns a run through 90 degrees.
Two metre waist-high guardrail section: silver top and middle rails on three flanged posts.
Short two-rail guardrail return that terminates a run.
L-shaped two-rail guardrail module that turns a run through 90 degrees.

Maintained liminal office carpet.

Office skirting trim: the maintained yellow wallpaper, darkened into a trim tint and given a modest satin sheen. Drawn by the automatic baseboard runs office wall materials receive.
Water-damaged office carpet.
Water-damaged office ceiling.
Pale commercial tile for the pool deck: glazed, so a restrained visible sheen, never a mirror.
Smaller-format pale tile for the empty basin floor and steps: glazed, with a restrained visible sheen.
Commercial wall tile for the pool room and basin walls: a restrained glazed sheen, not a glossy panel.
Sterile painted ceiling panel for the pool room.
Orientation-revealing wall used by the rendering diagnostic.
Orientation-revealing floor used by the rendering diagnostic.
Orientation-revealing ceiling used by the rendering diagnostic.

Final artwork: water-damaged office ceiling.
RGBA diagnostic sheet with a transparent margin and a translucent ring.
Deliberately non-power-of-two, non-square diagnostic sheet (96x64).
Concentric-ring diagnostic sheet for ceiling orientation.
Checker-and-arrow diagnostic sheet for floor orientation.
Stripe-and-arrow diagnostic sheet for wall orientation.

Final artwork: maintained liminal office wallpaper.
Commercial 15 cm deck tile at a 1.5 m repeat.
Small-format 10 cm basin tile at a 1 m repeat.
Commercial 10 cm wall tile at a 1 m repeat.
Sterile painted ceiling panel at a 2 m repeat.
Recessed twin-tube ceiling fixture used throughout the office interiors. The named PNG is the fixture's visible diffuser face, drawn once across the panel; the geometry stays generated.
Round recessed downlight for the pool room ceiling; mounts like a ceiling fixture. The named PNG is the diffuser face seen from below.
Wall-mounted pool luminaire; author `mount: "wall"` and a world `y` for each placed fixture. The named PNG is the luminaire's lens face.
Floor-direction wayfinding arrow, an external PNG cut-out that can be replaced without a Rust change.
Diagonal hazard striping, an external PNG cut-out that can be replaced without a Rust change.
Low-poly ceiling supply grille, an external PNG cut-out sized to sit centred on one 0.6 m ceiling tile.
Final pool safety sign sheet: the authoritative PNG lives under assets/ and can be replaced without a Rust change.
Internal validation marking used by the rendering diagnostic.
Low-poly tuxedo cat placed through the ordinary prop placement system.
Nearly transparent glass sheet: a faint green-grey tint and a barely-there alpha.
Unwashed glass sheet: blotchy alpha, a dried-film tint and a few drip trails.
Uniformly tinted teal glass sheet at roughly half opacity.
Polished linoleum sheet: pale speckled field with faint sheet seams.
Brushed metal sheet with a panel seam and two rivet rows.
Warm brass with a fine circular polish; the material carries the highlight.
Moulded plastic sheet: pale, near-neutral, softly periodic.
Tangent-space normal sheet with soft moulded dimples; generic detail, not aligned to any albedo.
Tangent-space normal sheet with fine horizontal brushing; generic detail, not aligned to any albedo.
Clear glazing for a window opening: almost no tint, a smooth glass sheen, and a transparent sheet. Author it on an opening with `glass`.
Unwashed window glazing: grimy alpha and a duller sheen than clean glass.
Tinted glazing at roughly half opacity, for observation windows between rooms.
Translucent backlit sign panel: a tinted sheet that emits on its own, which is what a transparent emissive material looks like.
A backlit sign panel on a failing ballast: the same translucent sheet as `core:glass_sign_lit_01`, driven by a level's `animated_emissions` flicker so it stutters instead of holding steady.

Deliberately waxed linoleum: a buffed sheen with a faint probe reflection, the polished end of the family. Ordinary institutional floors should author `shine` 0.0-0.1 on the surface instead of using this default.

Aged brushed metal: a cool tinted sheen, broad highlights and a faint environmental reflection plus a fine directional normal map, so it reads as metal rather than as grey paint without becoming chrome. Raise `shine` on a deliberately polished fixture.
Polished brass for door furniture; high shine without a planar mirror.
Moulded plastic: a broad white sheen and soft dimples, the deliberate counterpart of the brushed metal panel. Satin plastic, not a lacquered wall.
Wet deck tile: the shipped deck artwork with a wet sheen and a planar reflection, so a patch of floor reads as standing water without behaving like a mirror.

Translucent pool water for authored water volumes: the volume's own opacity rides in the surface's vertex alpha, so the material stays fully opaque (opacity 1.0) and one material serves every pool. Modest sheen only; water never reflects as a mirror.
Tileable pale pool water at a 2 m repeat: soft multi-scale caustics over a faint diagonal ripple. Drawn only by the water surface.
Flat painted wall: no sheen at all, the default for materials that author no surface-response fields. Kept explicit as the dull end of the comparison.
Alpha cut-out grille sheet: slats are solid, the openings between them are transparent.
Painted steel transfer grille: an alpha-tested cut-out that fills an opening with slats instead of a pane.
Soft white-grey wispy puff with an alpha falloff to every edge; sampled by steam effect billboards at the effect material's `tile_metres`.
Ambient steam: a soft white-grey puff at low opacity, no tint, no emission and no reflection. The default material for `effects[]` steam plumes.

The shared untextured sheet: a flat opaque white fill the renderer binds to fixture housings, plain body geometry and any texture slot with nothing better to show. Not artwork and not tileable; loaded once at renderer startup as a single un-mipped level.
Clean off-white residential wallpaper: a fine paper weave with no pattern.
Off-white wallpaper with one very subtle repeating motif on a 25 cm cell.
Plain painted off-white wall: a roller-stipple micro-texture, no pattern.
Residential wood skirting: horizontal grain, restrained, no damage.
Painted white skirting: smooth finish with a fine brush grain.
Varnished handrail wood: warm, fine straight grain.
Transition-strip hardwood: a warm oak tone with fine grain.
Finished oak floorboards, 20 cm planks, warm and clean.
Finished walnut floorboards, 15 cm planks, darker and cooler than the oak.
Clean cream short-pile carpet, no stains and no metre checker.
Simple 15 cm off-white floor tile with a fine grout line.
Flat white painted ceiling, near-flat with a faint roller variation.
Fine plaster ceiling: a very light stipple, not a popcorn texture.
Light cedar sauna boards: narrow vertical staves with soft even grain.
White painted door stock: a smooth finish with a faint vertical brush.
Clean canonical residential wallpaper; matte, no damage.
The same paper in a very subtle repeating motif; still matte.
Plain painted wall: distinct from wallpaper, a low satin response.
Wood skirting; used on baseboard and railing trim faces.
Painted white skirting for walls the wood board would not suit.
Varnished handrail and guardrail wood; a restrained satin sheen.
Floor transition strip; independent of the floors it joins.
Primary residential hardwood: a finished warm oak floor.
Secondary hardwood: darker walnut, a genuinely different floor.
Clean beige/cream residential carpet; matte and undamaged.
Simple kitchen/bathroom tile; a restrained glazed response.
Flat white residential ceiling.
Lightly textured plaster ceiling; subtle, not popcorn.
Light cedar for sauna doors and benches; a restrained satin sheen.
Satin white door paint; the default interior door leaf and frame finish.
Ordinary circular residential flush-mount ceiling lamp: a white diffuser disc in a shallow drum body, warm white light.
Off-white shaker base cabinet with a laminate countertop; 0.6 m wide so a run tiles cleanly.
Off-white wall cabinet with two doors and a slim carcass; mounts above the base cabinet.
Grey concrete artist's lay figure with three selectable poses on one rig (pose_stand, pose_arms_up, pose_arms_forward).
Low-poly rat with articulated legs, paws and a five-segment tail; looping idle/walk/run clips with measured reference speeds (0.199 m/s walk, 0.573 m/s run).
Low-poly articulated skeleton prop with a real animation rig and three held poses (pose_stand, pose_sit_floor, pose_sit_chair); the chair pose fits the 0.45 m seat of core:chair.

Carved pumpkin with a candle and an emissive flame primitive on the animated flame node; hopping loop hop_forward (authored for 0.5 m/s) and the laughing loop laugh (2.4 s). Attach a glow component with socket flame for the candle light.

Painted sheet ghost with a readable face on a three-joint rig; floating loop float_forward (authored for 0.3 m/s) and idle sway, plus blended materials with a mild cyan cloth glow and a dimmer face-feature primitive. Use fade and glow components for its cycle.

Walking skeleton whose skull is replaced by an emissive pumpkin head on the piece_pumpkin_head joint; in-place walk loop (authored for 0.571 m/s) and the collapse_reassemble gesture. Attach a glow component with socket piece_pumpkin_head for the head light.
Table knife with a tapered steel blade and a dark riveted handle; the blade end faces +Z in a place setting.
Four-tine table fork with a steel head and a dark riveted handle; the tines face +Z in a place setting.
Table spoon with a shallow eight-sided steel bowl and a dark riveted handle; the bowl faces +Z in a place setting.
Porcelain dinner plate; floats on the tabletop at any placement.
Porcelain cereal bowl with a rolled rim; sized for the home tabletop.
Small potted table plant: a glazed ten-sided pot, soil and seven folded leaves on a short stem; roughly half the height of the floor plant.
Yellow rubber duck with an orange beak and painted eyes; the beak end faces +Z and a `float` block lets it ride the pool surface.
Tileable night lawn: short mottled blades in muted greens, no bright or dark edge band, readable under a small pool of warm lamplight.
Stylized packed dirt with scattered pale gravel; tileable in both axes and deliberately low-contrast so a feathered edge blends into grass.
Restrained poured-concrete walkway: pale grey with subtle panel grain and a few darker pores, tileable in both axes.
Horizontal painted clapboard siding in a muted dark green-grey, tileable in both axes.
Dark asphalt roof shingles in overlapping rows, tileable in both axes.
Equirectangular 2:1 night sky: near-black with a small number of faint stars in the upper hemisphere and no moon, Milky Way, glow or daylight horizon.
Night lawn surface: low sheen so a small warm lamp pool reads without a wet sheen.
Walked dirt path surface.
Cast concrete walkway surface.
Painted exterior wall cladding.
Exterior roof surface.

Straight path-edge feather strip: the dirt/gravel grain fades out across the strip width so a dirt patch meets grass without a hard rectangular seam. Place with width across the seam and height along the edge; rotate to face either side or a diagonal run.
Rounded path-end feather: grain fades radially so a path can stop, fork or flare into gravel without a cut edge.
Corner feather piece for a path bend or junction: two soft fades meeting at a rounded inner corner.
Standing tuft of alpha-cutout grass cards for LOW-density scatter; non-solid, does not occlude the light bake.
Taller standing grass cluster for MEDIUM and DENSE scatter; non-solid, does not occlude the light bake.
Large stylized tree: tapered trunk, four branches and an alpha-cutout leaf canopy. Place it solid with a level size of roughly [0.8, 6.4, 0.8] so only the trunk blocks the player.
Ground-standing garden lamp on a short post: a dark housing with a warm emissive pane. Author its point light at offset [0, 0.86, 0] (the documented mounting origin).
Small cap lamp for a fence post: the bracket seats on a 0.12 m post and the warm emissive pane faces +Z. Author its point light at offset [0, 0.30, 0.05].
Building/eave-hanging lantern: an arched bracket meets the wall at y = 0.52 and the lamp hangs below it. Author its point light at offset [0, 0.18, 0.12].
Simple capped fence post; supports outdoor:lamp_fence and gives a run of posts a repeated silhouette.
Modular exterior wall panel: siding on both faces with a painted base band and corner boards. Use level size [3.0, 2.7, 0.24] and solid true, or butt it against real level walls.
Exterior wall panel with a centered framed window, sill and dark glazing; the window is decorative and the panel stays solid.

Exterior wall panel with a centered 1.1 x 2.15 m doorway: real jamb depth through the panel, a lintel and a threshold board. Non-solid; the level authors a real wall with a door opening behind it. Eave lamp mounts are documented at [+/-1.15, 2.55, 0.20] local.
Pitched roof slope with a visible eave: shingle field on top, fascia and soffit board at the low edge, origin at the eave's underside centre so a slope can be butted against a gable.
Ridge cap that covers the joint where two roof slopes meet.
Vertical corner board that covers panel junctions at a house corner.
Low cast step joining a concrete walkway or dirt path to a doorway threshold without a large step; set the level size with solid true when the player should stand on it.

Deliberately tiny 6 cm grey cube that carries an authored invisible containment collider, not scenery: place it solid: true with the collider's real size (e.g. [0.3, 3.0, 3.0]), set occludes: false and author a y that buries the cube below the local floor, so the drawn geometry is never visible and the bake never sees it.

Small painted sheet ghost cat on a five-joint rig; floating loop float_forward (authored for 0.2 m/s) and an idle sway, sharing the sheet ghost's blended cyan cloth contract. Use fade and glow components for its cycle.
Slender birch: pale bark with dark flecks, thin branches and an airy alpha-cutout leaf canopy. Place it solid with a level size of roughly [0.6, 6.2, 0.6] so only the trunk blocks the player.
Conifer: a tapered trunk under five to six stacked ragged evergreen tiers. Place it solid with a level size of roughly [0.6, 6.8, 0.6] so only the trunk blocks the player.

Tall streetlight on a 6 m post with a top arm and a downward-facing warm lantern head. Author its point light at offset [0, 6.05, 0.43] under the pane (the hood shadows upward, so the pool stays on the ground); the catalogued 1.2 m depth includes the arm and the head's hood, and the emitter anchor is inside that box.
Straight 1.8 m porch railing module: top and bottom rails with balusters, origin at the floor, centred on the run. Non-solid dressing over a prop or wall collider.
Right-angle porch railing corner joining two straight modules around a 0.12 m post; the two rail ends meet at the module grid so a run has no gap.
Porch railing terminal: a short rail end and a newel cap closing a run without a gap.
Square porch support post with a flat cap seat at y = 1.05; the railing support piece and the seat for a porch roof.

themes.description: Institutional office interiors: liminal wallpaper, carpet, panel ceilings, fluorescent light and office furniture.
Public swimming pool interiors: pale commercial tile, a sterile ceiling, white resin furniture, privacy curtains, chrome and silver metalwork, cool light and the NO DIVING sign.

Ordinary residential interiors: clean off-white wallpaper and paint, hardwood and cream carpet floors, a simple kitchen tile, painted baseboards and trim, flat and plaster ceilings, warm white flush-mount ceiling light and simple kitchen cabinetry.
Night exterior: a dark starry sky, tileable grass ground, a dirt and gravel path with feathered edges, a restrained concrete walkway, a leafy tree, warm exterior lamps and modular house facade parts.
